# Jeremy Collins

> Software engineer at Webflow in Los Angeles. Makes Codable and Taktung for iOS.

## About

Jeremy Collins is a senior software engineer at Webflow. His recent work is growth engineering: billing, usage metering, paywalls, and customer-facing product. Outside of work he makes Codable, a free iOS app that brings web developer tools to mobile Safari, and Taktung, a free iOS app for Vercel deploy and incident ops. No ads, tracking, or paywall.

## Apps

- [Codable on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/codable/id1324741659): Safari-native inspector, console, network monitor, scratchpad, and viewport tester for iOS
- [Taktung on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/taktung/id6805738660): Vercel deploy and incident ops on iPhone. Site health, deploys, confirmed promote or rollback
